title: Cantor: no injection from a power set into its base
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For every type $X$ and every function $f:\mathcal P(X)\to X$, the function $f$ is not injective. Here $\mathcal P(X)$ is the set of all subsets of $X$.
